description: This file defines the code-behind for the 'Edit Catalog Item' Razor Page in the admin section of the web application. It includes dependencies, authorization, model binding, and handlers for get and post requests related to editing catalog items.

classes.name: EditCatalogItemModel
classes.description: PageModel class for handling the editing of a catalog item in the admin section. Manages GET and POST requests to load and save catalog item data.

methods.name: EditCatalogItemModel
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ICatalogItemViewModelService dependency.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to load the page with the specified catalog item model.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the catalog item if the ModelState is valid, then redirects to the admin index page.
